research_evidence: The supplied Android video shows the process exiting immediately after selecting an anchored product. HomeScreen inspection found IndexedStack kept the Anchor Setup AR camera mounted while ResolveAnchorScreen created a second AR session; native dispose also destroyed SceneView before removing point-cloud children.

task.title: Prevent Product Finder from opening a second concurrent Android AR session. [bugfix] [tdd:required]
task.definition_of_done: Only the visible LiveMap destination owns an AR camera; switching from Anchor Setup disposes its AR view before Product Finder can open Resolve; native point-cloud nodes are removed before the scene is destroyed; regression tests, analysis, and release APK build pass.
